meta.promptText: Which moisturizer should I buy for dry skin in Indian winters?

response.text:
For **dry skin during Indian winters**, I’d prioritize a **cream with ceramides + glycerin/hyaluronic acid**, rather than a lightweight gel. Winter’s lower humidity can weaken the skin barrier and increase water loss. [www.cetaphil.in](https://www.cetaphil.in/skincare-tips/skin-concern/how-to-take-care-of-dry-skin-in-winter.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My top picks

### [CeraVe Moisturising Cream]()
*₹356*

### [Cetaphil Moisturising Cream]()
*₹791*

### [Bioderma Atoderm Creme Ultra-Nourishing Cream]()
*₹629*

### [Re'equil Ceramide & Hyaluronic Acid Moisturiser]()
*₹266*

### [Cetaphil DAM Daily Advance Ultra Hydrating Lotion]()
*₹414*

**🥇 Best overall: CeraVe Moisturising Cream**  
If your skin gets **very dry, flaky or tight**, this would be my first choice. It combines three essential ceramides with hyaluronic acid and has a richer cream texture suited to winter. [www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/beauty-blog/top-moisturizer-for-dry-skin?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**💰 Best value: Re'equil Ceramide & Hyaluronic Acid Moisturiser**  
A good Indian option if you want a ceramide-based moisturizer without spending as much as on some imported brands.

**🌿 Best for sensitive/very dry skin: Bioderma Atoderm Crème Ultra**  
A particularly good option if your skin feels uncomfortable or easily irritated in winter.

**🧴 Budget-friendly classic: Cetaphil Moisturising Cream / DAM**  
Great if you want something straightforward and rich. Cetaphil specifically recommends its richer moisturizers for winter dryness. [www.cetaphil.in](https://www.cetaphil.in/skincare-tips/skin-concern/how-to-take-care-of-dry-skin-in-winter.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### If I had to pick just one
**Buy CeraVe Moisturising Cream** if budget isn't a major concern. Apply it to **slightly damp skin immediately after washing**; that helps reduce moisture loss. [www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/beauty-blog/top-moisturizer-for-dry-skin?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me your **budget (e.g. ₹300/₹500/₹1,000), whether this is for face or body, and whether you're acne-prone**, I can narrow it down to the best 1–2 options for you.
